pages.text: $(thing)Western Corn Rootworm$() ($(o)Diabrotica virgifera virgifera$()), insect.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() maize.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 12-32 °C (best 24 °C).

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 1 years (eggs in soil).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 40% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Rotate maize with soybean; Bt rootworm hybrids.$(br2)A classic case for crop rotation; a rotation-resistant strain now lays eggs in soybean fields.
